body:
### Description

I was testing things locally and noticed this:

### To Reproduce

```py
import pytest

import cupy 
from cupy import testing


@testing.parameterize(*testing.product({
    'n': [None, 5, 10, 15],
    'shape': [(10, 7), (10,), (10, 10)],
    'norm': [None, 'ortho'],
}))
class Test1dCallbacks:

    x = 1

    @testing.for_float_dtypes(no_float16=True)
    @testing.numpy_cupy_allclose(rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-7, contiguous_check=False)
    def test_cb(self, xp, dtype):
        if self.x == 1:
            pytest.skip("ha")
        return xp.zeros(1, dtype=dtype)
```

Output:
```
============================================================= test session starts =============================================================
platform linux -- Python 3.10.12, pytest-7.4.2, pluggy-1.3.0
rootdir: /home/leof/dev/cupy_cuda122
configfile: setup.cfg
collected 24 items                                                                                                                            

tests/cupy_tests/fft_tests/test_pytest.py ........................                                                                      [100%]

============================================================= 24 passed in 0.15s ==============================================================
```

If I remove `@testing.for_float_dtypes(no_float16=True)` and the `dtype` argument, the skipped tests will be shown correctly.

### Installation

Built from GitHub source

### Environment

_No response_

### Additional Information

Tried with pytest 7.4.2/7.3.2.
title: `cupy.testing.for*dtypes()` seem to turn skipped tests into passed
